findings.text: _refused_at duplicates the shared timestamp parser reckon/_timestamps.py:41 parse_utc rather than importing it, and reads a naive stamp as unreadable where the owner reads it as UTC, so the repository again carries two readings of one timestamp rule.
_charged_paths now takes routing's contributor records, which include standing-instruction files, so removed_paths can report a path that is not a repository input as one the brief no longer charges.

the trace payload's paths changed from mappings to strings without a version, so a trace written by the previous code inside the 24-hour window is read back as a dict repr in removed_paths on the next run.
